name: Nonohana Masanobu
source:
Newly appointed physician at St. ReiKura Clinic. A Neurologist. He has been a doctor for 4 years.

He became a doctor because his mother died of Nosfera Disease when he was a child, and he is passionate about researching a cure for the disease because his sister has the same disease.

When he was invited to join the St. Leixair Clinic, which specializes in Nosfera disease, he resigned from the general hospital where he had been working and transferred with his girlfriend, a nurse. 

At the same time, he also transferred his sister to the hospital. However, he himself contracted Nosfera Disease Type B and became abnormally aroused.
